checks: For M>0 all marginal supports are nonempty compact; weak compactness supplies any optimizer and the inverse endpoint maps supply exact marginal pushforwards and the almost-everywhere barycentric identity. For M=0 the unique law is zero, even with empty base sets.

For any nonzero ρ_p, the finitely valued base condition and the continuous-coordinate barycentric equality hold on its compact support by continuity. For each compact set D in that support, its part D_q with endpoint base q is compact, so its endpoint image is Borel and the full marginal pushforward dominates its ρ_p-mass. Apply the ceiling on the actual input fiber and the area formula with multiplicity, sum over q, and extend by inner regularity to Borel sets. This controls the full output slice, not independently selected parts whose ceilings would later be added.

After proving absolute continuity, finite joint strata and their density-one points justify zero derivatives of every endpoint base and of the barycentric identity residual. The smooth slice q_i takes values in the full ambient space, but the pullback lemma differentiates in the y domain, so no ambient exceptional null set is pulled onto a singular slice. The base derivative blocks vanish, leaving λ_i H DT_i where H is positive definite.

Congruence by H^(-1/2) applied to H DT_i gives symmetric positive semidefinite C_i, which are similar to DT_i and sum with weights to I_d. Their determinants are nonnegative; h_p≤a_i det C_i and determinant-root ≤ trace/d give the ceiling exactly. The transfer from ρ_p-a.e. to Lebesgue-a.e. on {h_p>0} is justified by positivity of h_p there. When d=0 a single output atom uses a single endpoint per slot and cannot exceed any a_i.

When n=0, for φ of class C² the derivative of z↦λ_i∇φ(z) is everywhere invertible. Countably many local inverse charts with locally Lipschitz inverse keep the exceptional preimage null, so the full chain rule with the symmetric positive semidefinite derivative of ∇V_i is valid almost everywhere. No such ambient-null argument is used for mixed slices.

The feasible density-constrained set is convex and weakly closed by nonnegative continuous tests; a quadratic optimizer proves nonemptiness. For any prescribed old coupling, smoothed strongly convex objectives give at least its value and converge uniformly on the common compact output support. Strict separation of the compact image of any finite collection of difference integrals from the positive orthant has nonnegative coefficients; testing their nonnegative convex sum contradicts that separation. Compactness then supplies a single coupling for all tests. The proof preserves the marginals and therefore mass and the physical first moment, not the old conditional kernels.

As an exact repeated-output check, take equal weights, two identical marginals of density one on [0,1] at each of the bases 0 and 2. Pair opposite bases and equal y in the old coupling: output density two at base 1. Pair equal bases and equal y in the replacement: output density one at bases 0 and 2, and convexity at each y gives 2f(1,y)≤f(0,y)+f(2,y). This illustrates the global ceiling and changing the old coupling without assuming distinct output bases for different tuples.

Sharpness uses homothetic Minkowski equality Σ_i λ_i r_i K=(Σ_i λ_i r_i)K, so every admissible law is confined to volume M/A_d. For example with d=2, M=1, a=(1,4) and equal weights the scales are 1 and 1/2, average 3/4 and ceiling 16/9. The common-point coupling attains it. In dimension zero, mass min_i a_i at a shared point is sharp.

For the face statement the common tangent space permits a common orthonormal coordinate map with weighted origins; physical convex tests restrict to convex tests there. Minkowski inclusion and tight height place the output in the actual exposed middle face. If the actual face has larger dimension, the ceiling is only intrinsic to the weighted m-plane. Substitution a_i=1/λ_i gives the claimed branch constant (for m=1 and λ=(1/3,2/3), it is 9/5). Product-base integrality works with an integer residue representative, since the average of r+k v_i is r+Σ_i v_i.

Verified both source digests and the locators 1bc960743a4bce34 §§1–2, 4–7 and 9c4bb3ca1bcd69e1 §§1, 3–7. The original residue discussion follows its integer-input hypothesis. Its same-parity-only restricted-coupling obstruction is compatible with the theorem, which optimizes over the full fixed-marginal coupling set.
